paite: Huaiziak in mihing aw, miselhat kuapeuh himah lechin paulam himhim na nei kei hi. Midang na selna mah ah nangmah leh nangmah siam louh na kitan hi. Nang selhat in leng huchibang thilte na hih sam ngal hi.
heading: Judate Khelhna
english: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.

paite: Huchibang thilhih nakte tung ah Pathian' vaihawmna diktak in atung, chih i thei uhi.
english: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.

paite: Mihing aw, huchibang thilhih nakte gensia, nang leng huchibang na hih sam ngal nak a, Pathian' vaihawmna pelh na kigingta a hia?
english: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?

paite: Ahihkeileh Pathian hoihna kisikna a nang hon pi ding a om ahi chih thei lou in, ahoihna, athuaktheihna leh adohtheihna hauhnate na ngaineu a hia?
english: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?

paite: Himahleh na lungtang khauh leh kisik utlouhnate ziak in, na tung ah thangpaihna na kholkhawmte Pathian' vaihawmna diktat hong kilatna, thangpaihna ni chiang a ding a kholkhawm ahi zaw hi.
english: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,

paite: Pathian in michih athilhih bang zel un ahawmsak ding;
english: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”

paite: Thil hoih hih teitei a, thupina leh pahtawina leh manthat theihlouhna zong mite kiang ah tangtawn hinna ape ding hi.
english: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

paite: Himahleh genhakte, thutak zui lou a, gitlouhna zui zawte tung ah, hehna leh thangpaihna, haksatna leh lungkhamna thupitak a-om dia;
english: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,

paite: mihing thil hihkhial tengteng kha tung ah a-om ding, Juda mi kha tung ah a-om masa ding a, huan, Grik mi kha tung ah a-om nawn ding hi.
english: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

paite: Himahleh, thil hoih hih peuhmahte kiang ah thupina, pahtawina, khamuanna piak ahi ding, Juda mi kiang ah piak ahi masa ding a, huan, Grik mi kiang ah ahi nawn ding hi.
english: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

paite: Pathian in mi deihsak tuam anei ngal kei hi.
english: For there is no partiality with God.

paite: Kuapeuh dan nei lou a thil hihkhial, dan lou in amangthang ding hi; kuapeuh dan nei a thil hihkhial, dan bang in vaihawm in a-om ding.
english: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.

paite: Dan zami phette Pathian mitmuh in midik ahi kei ua; dan zuite midik ahi zaw ding uhi.
english: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified

paite: Dan nei lou Zentelte'n amau pianpih a dan thilte ahih un, amau dan nei kei mah le uh, amau leh amau dan in akinei tawm uhi.
english: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,

paite: Alungtang uah dan thilhih gelh ahi chih langsak ding in asia-le-pha theihna un atheihpih hi; alungsimte un leng theihpih ahih ziak in angaihtuahna un siam louh atangsak hiam siam atangsak zel hi.
english: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)

paite: Ka tanchinhoih gen bang in, Pathian vaihawm ni chiang in mihing thugukte, Jesu Khrist ah angaihtuah ding hi.
english: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.

paite: Himahleh nang Juda na kichi a, dan a kinga in Pathian na suang hi.
heading: Judate Leh Mosi Dan
english: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,

paite: Adeihlam na thei a, thil hoihzawte hoih na sa a, dan a hilh in na om a,
english: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

paite: nangmah mittawte pipa, mial lak a omte vakna hi in na kigingta hi.
english: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,

paite: Dan ah pilna leh thutak omdan na theih ziak in, mipilloute hilhpilpa, naungekte hilhpa in na kigingta hi.
english: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.

paite: Huchibang na hih ngalleh nang midangte hilhpa, nangmah na kihilh kei a hia? Nang guta lou dia mite hilhpa, nang na gu nak maw?
english: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?

paite: Nang angkawm lou dia hilhpa, nang ang na kawm maw? Nang milim hopa, nang milim tempul a thilte na gu nak maw?
english: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

paite: Nang dan suangpa, nang dan a na tatlek ziak in Pathian na hihminse zel ahi maw?
english: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?

paite: "Pathian min noumau ziak in Zentelte lak ah gensiat in a-omta hi," chi a kigelh bang in.
english: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.

paite: Dan zuipa na hihleh zeksum aphatuam ngíal hi; dan a talekpa na hihleh bel, na zeksum sum louh bang phet ahong hita hi.
english: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

paite: Huaiziak in zek sumloumi in dan thusehte azuihleh azeksum louh, sum bang a sim ahi kei dia hia?
english: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?

paite: Huan amau sa a zeksum louh in dan azuih kim uleh, nang dan thu gelh leh zeksum nei ngal a dan a talekpa ahon mohpaih kei ding ua hia?
english: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?

paite: Alang lel a Juda mi hih zaw Juda mi tak ahi kei a; alang a sa lel a zeksum zaw zeksum tak ahi tuan sam kei hi.
english: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;

paite: Himahleh alang lel hilou a, Juda mi zaw, Juda mi tak ahi; huan zeksum tak, lungsim a sum ahi, laigelh thu phet ah hilou in, kha ah ahi; huai mi'n mihing phat aloh kei a, Pathian phat aloh zaw ahi.
english: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.
